name: Jill Tokuda
page_title: Jill Tokuda's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (HI) - District 2

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "As Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson warned, today's decision is not a victory. It is only a delay. This fight is not over. We must protect women's reproductive rights and codify Roe."

"Everyone should have access to the reproductive healthcare they need, and I will keep fighting until every person has the freedom to make decisions about their own body, life, and future, without interference from politicians."

"The Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade remains one of the biggest threats to women across our country. Reproductive decisions are deeply personal and should remain in the hands of women, not dictated by politicians."
Rated 100% by the Planned Parenthood Action Fund

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "We must raise the debt ceiling to fulfill our country’s financial obligations to pay for past debt and uphold our responsibility to Americans relying on Social Security, Medicare, and other critical federal programs. #JillontheJob"
"protect Social Security and Medicare"
Rated 100% by the Alliance for Retired Americans

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "I'm running for Congress to fight for our fair share of federal funds to increase access to healthcare services, build workforce housing, keep our neighborhoods safe and protect our natural resources. "

"The #ChildTaxCredit was the largest tax cut for working families in a generation. We must enact the #AmericanFamilyAct to make it permanent to help working families get ahead and provide financial security in the face of rising costs. #ChildTaxCreditNOW #JillontheJob"
Rated 59% by FreedomWorks

positions.question: Do you support a wealth tax in order to pay for public programs?

evidence.text: "As a working mom, I see every day as an opportunity to fight for our families and reduce income inequality."
Rated 59% by FreedomWorks

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by End Citizens United

"Elections must empower people, not money. To demonstrate my commitment to this principle, I have refused to accept corporate PAC money from day one of my campaign. My determination to overturn Citizens United is driven by the clear harm it does to our democracy, enabling unchecked spending by corporations and the wealthy."
"I look forward to getting to Congress as we strive to overturn Citizens United and pass meaningful campaign finance reform!"

"My stance is clear: democracy must prioritize every voice equally and protect the electorate’s power from being eclipsed by special interests and deep pockets. This fight for campaign finance reform is more than a policy position; it’s a commitment to the very heart of democracy, ensuring our electoral system represents and serves every citizen fairly."

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "If we are to strengthen and uphold our values as a country, then we must show that words matter, and actions have consequences. I have full faith and confidence that this case will proceed fairly through our legal system and that he will be held fully accountable for any and all transgressions committed."

"The murder of Tyre Nichols at the hands of the Memphis police is unconscionable. As the mother of two young boys, I am beyond infuriated & heartbroken. My prayers are with Tyre’s parents and family."
"The rule of law is a pillar of any democracy, and that means that no one, including former presidents, are above the law."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 8774: "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2025"

"The NDAA passed out of committee nearly unanimously. Today extremist Republicans hijacked the bill and loaded it with attacks on reproductive care & LGTBQ+ people. Despite many crucial Hawai‘i priorities I fought for - I had to vote no."
Voted against HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted against HR 4365: "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2024"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "I am thrilled to help announce $115.5 million in funding to invest in broadband infrastructure in Hawaiʻi and expand reliable internet access for rural communities. The digital divide is real in Hawaiʻi and we need to do everything we can to increase access and digital literacy."

"In #Kona today to tour @KOA_Airport & discuss one of five runway projects moving forward this year thanks to an infusion of federal funding. The $87.6M runway project for #KonaAirport is an investment in infrastructure that keeps our people, businesses & communities connected."

"Mahalo @RepRickLarsen, Ranking Member of the House Transportation & Infrastructure Committee, for joining me in Lahaina to see ongoing efforts, meet w/ @fema, & the @USCG. Looking forward to working w/ you to bring the full force of the federal government to aid in our recovery!"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "NAHASDA has been critical to creating affordable housing opportunities for Native Hawaiians. I’m grateful to @SenBrianSchatz and @IndianCommittee for their hard work in reauthorizing this important program. Let’s get this over the finish line!"

"The need for affordable housing is more urgent than ever. To provide immediate relief, I advocate for the continuation of enhanced child tax credits through legislation like the American Family Act and the expansion of the earned income tax credit, putting more money back into the pockets of families and workers."

"This week's #MauiMinute highlighted Maui's housing crisis, exacerbated by the August fires, with people being shuffled from one hotel to another. As we rebuild, we must remember to live aloha, and ensure that the stability and security of a home are provided to our Maui ʻohana."

""Hawai‘i has one of the highest costs of living in the country, which means that too many of our people are getting priced out of paradise. We need sustainable career pathways that lead to well-paying jobs that make it possible for our people to work, live, and thrive in rural and remote America."

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Funding quality public education for students of all ages is one of the most valuable investments for the future of Hawai‘i because a well-educated population is the foundation of a thriving community."

"I applaud @POTUS’s historic action in cancelling up to $20,000 in student loan debt for millions of Americans. Today’s victory serves as a reminder that we need to do more to ensure that higher education is within reach for every family. #CancelStudentDebt"
"I’m rallying in front of the Supreme Court to demand that the justices uphold President Biden’s student debt relief plan for millions of borrowers, including over 100,000 people in Hawai’i."
Rated 100% by the National Education Association

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "A 17-year-old in my district was supposed to start her first job last week, but instead she's in the hospital fighting for her life because of a senseless act of gun violence. Our current gun safety laws are clearly not enough, and Americans deserve action from Congress."

"As a mother, the epidemic of gun violence in our country deeply affects me. It’s heartbreaking and unacceptable that our children aren’t safe in schools, and that ordinary activities like grocery shopping, attending church, or going to work have become dangerous due to rampant gun violence. The time to end this violence is now"
"How many lives do we have to lose before Republicans in Congress act on gun reform? "

"My dedication to addressing critical issues is unwavering – from tackling gun violence in our communities to guaranteeing equitable healthcare and mental healthcare access. These are not just policy goals; they are moral imperatives, deeply ingrained in who we are as a community."

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: " I was proud to stand with many of my colleagues to sponsor the Medicare for All Act of 2023. Getting sick or injured should never be the reason why someone goes into crippling debt. Healthcare is a human right, and I will continue to fight for this critical legislation until equitable healthcare is a reality for all."

"My dedication to addressing critical issues is unwavering – from tackling gun violence in our communities to guaranteeing equitable healthcare and mental healthcare access. These are not just policy goals; they are moral imperatives, deeply ingrained in who we are as a community."

"The Affordable Care Act is under attack, threatening the healthcare coverage of 45M people including more than 64k in Hawaii. W/out the ACA, preventive care will no longer be free & seniors will pay more for drugs. We cannot let this happen which is why I'm proud to #ProtectACA!"

"Today, on the 13th Anniversary of the Affordable Care Act, I joined Dem leaders to celebrate the #ACA & also highlight how Hawaiʻi helped pave the way by passing the Prepaid Health Care Act in 1974, providing employer-sponsored coverage for most employees."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "As a mother (and a Senator) who brought her newborn baby to work at the State Capitol everyday, I understand the reality of not being able to afford childcare. That's why I've been a strong supporter and advocate for paid family leave."
"As your Lt. Governor, I will put Families First, and fight every day for the state to act with urgency to get things done. "

"No worker should have to choose between their health and getting a paycheck. That's why I’m proud to help introduce the #FamilyAct to guarantee comprehensive family and medical leave & the #HealthyFamiliesAct to set national sick leave standards — it’s time we get this done!"

"Paid Family Leave has a mountain of benefits that would bring much-needed relief to families across Hawaiʻi. In the Senate, I fought hard to try and establish Paid Family Leave for our State. As Lieutenant Governor, I'll work hard to make this goal a reality. #TokudaForHawaii"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "Drass is an amazing 3rd grader from Keaʻau, Hawaiʻi who taught me how to fold an origami boat! He also has type 1 diabetes, and he told me about his glucose monitoring device and insulin pumps. His wish? That insulin is affordable for everyone and we work to find a cure."
"lower prescription drug prices and expand access to health care;"
